SEVERED PATCH 1 - CHANGE LOG

ADDITIONS
  • Added support for Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean languages
FIXES
  • Fix for issue where Citadel's final door could enter a permanently closed state if the player left midway through unlocking it
  • Fix to an abrupt animation skip that could occur when reentering the final boss fight after the player died in it
  • Fix to allow the end credits music time to fully finish playing out before ending the credits scene
